card.name: Ca-ution at start of caution sentences
card.fires_on: The ending "ution" of the word Caution (split as Ca + ution) when it opens a sentence in a drug label, as in "Caution is advised" or "Caution should be exercised".

modes.label: Caution is advised
modes.description: Sentence-initial Caution followed by is advised, in interaction or precaution text.
modes.example: Ca<<ution>> is advised for concomitant use of

modes.label: Caution should be exercised
modes.description: Sentence-initial Caution followed by should be exercised or taken or used, after a statement of a risk.
modes.example: Ca<<ution>> should be exercised in such individuals.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning caution or note, including Chinese ones like 注意事项 and 警惕.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a label sentence begins with "Caution" as a warning to be careful.
